name: Poster Rotator
description: Fill a local poster pool per movie from providers, then periodically rotate the Primary Poster image from the pool. This keeps Jellyfin looking fresh with rotating poster images on an interval of your choosing.

versions.changelog: Release 1.8.4.1: Targets Jellyfin 12.0.0.0 directly. Removes legacy backwards compatibility constraints and prior manifest lines. Adds UI configuration for pool size (1-50 posters per item) and direct pool deletion.
